title: Northrop YB-49 jet flying wing in flight over desert terrain
description: Aerial photograph of the Northrop YB-49 flying wing viewed from above as it flies over arid terrain, showing its vertical fins, trailing-edge jet exhausts, US star insignia and cockpit canopy. A figure number is typed in the right margin and an "A.C." photo number appears at lower right. Part of a report section on US flying wing aircraft.
